description: This PHP script interacts with Redmine API to fetch project and issue details, and to create new issues via XML payloads. It references external Redmine PHP API libraries and contains sample code for API requests and response handling.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A class for interacting with the Redmine REST API, providing methods to fetch projects, issues, and create issues

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for redmine class to initialize API URL and key

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Fetches a list of projects from Redmine

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific issue number

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine from an XML object
